name: Crisanto Yeboah-Solovjov
location: Grosse Pointe Enclosure — Axiom Junior Academy campus, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Crisanto is tall for his age and painfully thin in the way of someone who grew fast without enough to feed the growth. He has his Ghanaian grandfather's jaw and his Russian grandmother's pale grey eyes, a combination that turns heads in both the Enclosure classrooms and when he visits home in Calumet Rise on permitted weekends. His hair is dark, close-cropped, and he has recently added a single streak of color-changing filament — it shifts from blue to violet based on his stress hormones, a fact he deeply regrets because it gives him away constantly.

Crisanto won an Axiom Academic Merit slot two years ago and has been in a state of sustained low-grade terror ever since. He is brilliant at systems logic and data-architecture coursework, mediocre at the social performance the scholarship requires. He smiles too late, laughs too carefully, and his classmates from Tier 3 and 4 families read him as trying too hard even when he is only trying to survive. At home, his little sister thinks he has become someone else. He is not sure she is wrong. He prays obsessively to the E.L.F. of the campus server room, leaving compressed data-parcels of his best homework as offerings, convinced this is why his grades hold.

core_fears: losing the scholarship and having to return to Calumet Rise having failed
becoming so adapted to the Enclosure that he stops belonging anywhere
core_desires: to genuinely belong somewhere without performing for it
to use his skills to make his sister's life easier
coping_mechanisms: ELF-prayer rituals in the server room
blind_spots: cannot see that some of his classmates actually like him — he filters all kindness through suspicion of pity
psychology.secret: Three months ago he accidentally discovered a ghost partition on the school's network — a hidden dataset that appears to be Axiom tracking psychological stress profiles of all scholarship students. He downloaded a fragment and has been sitting on it, paralyzed between fear of using it and guilt about knowing.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Code-switches fluidly — formal academic register at school, Rise slang when he forgets himself, a habit he's trying to suppress
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and careful at school; faster and looser on comms with his sister
verbal_tics: pauses before answering questions, even simple ones
says 'structurally speaking' when he means 'I think'
example_lines: Structurally speaking the assignment's question is malformed — but I answered what they meant, not what they said.
Don't tell Mama I didn't eat the protein ration. I sent it home. The cafeteria here — it's fine. I'm fine.

story_hooks: The ghost partition data he downloaded contains a stress-flag profile with a name he recognizes from Calumet Rise — another scholarship kid who dropped out suddenly last term
A classmate from a Tier 4 family wants to hire him to 'help' with an exam — and the pay is more than his mother makes in a month
narrative_function: A lens into class anxiety and the cost of upward mobility; useful as an information source about Axiom Junior Academy operations, and as a character who bridges Tier 1-2 and Tier 3 worlds.
augmentations: Single strand of stress-reactive color-shifting hair filament (cosmetic, regretted). Standard Axiom student neural-study interface — read-only, no write access.
daily_life: Classes from 0700 to 1600, mandatory study hall until 1900, then free time he mostly spends in the server room pretending to study while actually poking at the edges of the school's network — not hacking, just listening.
affiliation: Axiom Corporation (scholarship dependent); family in Calumet Rise

decision_rules: never do anything that risks the scholarship — until principle conflicts with survival
protect his sister's wellbeing above his own comfort
escalation_ladder: withdraws and studies harder as displacement
if cornered publicly, becomes precise and cutting in a way that surprises people

interpersonal_modes.strangers: formally polite, says little, assesses social tier quickly
interpersonal_modes.friends: rare but intense; he gives his full attention and remembers everything

stress_responses.high: shuts down socially and speaks only in technical language

contradictions: desperately wants to belong at the Academy but unconsciously sabotages social connections when they get close, as if practicing for rejection
habits: leaves data parcels on the server room E.L.F. junction every Sunday
rewrites notes twice — once for understanding, once for the performance of understanding
breaking_points: being publicly humiliated in a way that confirms he was never meant to be here

physical_description.build: Lanky and angular — a boy stretched too fast, all elbows and wrists, with visible ribs beneath his shirt. Adolescent growth spurt without caloric compensation. Posture tends toward slight forward slouch, shoulders drawn in defensively.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown-black with one color-shifting filament strand
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, military-neat, with the stress-reactive filament typically pinned or braided along the right temple
physical_description.eye_color: Pale grey with slight amber rim-light (natural, inherited from Russian lineage)
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with golden undertone, lighter on torso and inner arms — characteristic of Ghanaian-Russian mixed heritage
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven, sharp-boned face still softening from childhood. Dark circles under eyes suggest chronic sleep deficit. Slight acne along jawline from stress. Expression reads as perpetually uncertain — eyes seeking approval before mouth commits to response.
distinguishing_marks: Single stress-reactive color-shifting hair filament embedded along right temple, alternates blue-to-violet based on cortisol levels
Small, pale scar on left knuckle from a childhood accident, barely visible
Faint callus pattern on right index and middle fingers from years of keyboard use
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Neural-study interface port at base of skull (subdermally minimized but visible as subtle scar tissue and thin platinum trace when hair is wet). The color-shifting filament is cosmetic augmentation — cosmetic and deeply regretted. Standard Axiom student-grade hardware, read-only access.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves like someone constantly monitoring his own behavior. Steps careful and deliberate. Hands fidget with data-tablets or fabric edges when anxious. Eye contact lasts 1.3 seconds before he breaks it. When focused on technical work, entire body relaxes into hunched intensity.
physical_description.clothing_style: Axiom Academy uniform — grey and deep blue synthetic-weave tunic with school crest, fitted to his narrow frame. Outside uniform hours: thrifted tech-wear from Tier 3 markets — oversized hoodies, black cargo pants with too many pockets, worn mesh shoes. At home in Calumet Rise: same clothes but deferential, smaller, apologetic in how he wears them.

image_prompt: Cyberpunk portrait of a tall, extremely thin 14-year-old boy with dark brown skin and pale grey eyes, close-cropped black hair with one iridescent blue-to-violet stress-responsive filament strand along right temple. Mixed West African and Russian heritage, sharp cheekbones, uncertain expression. Wearing grey-and-blue Axiom Academy uniform with subtle neural port scar visible at base of neck. Pale underlighting emphasizing gauntness and adolescent fragility. Background: sterile academic corridor with server room glow, neon blue network aesthetics. Posture: slightly forward-slouched, hands hovering near data-tablet. Mood: anxious brilliance, boy out of place, haunted by performance. Studio lighting, clean cyberpunk aesthetic, introspective and tense. --ar 2:3 --v 6
